g.text: Grey = self-pair, no shared evaluated games, or fewer than 10 games / 3 match days. Grey does not mean zero.

g.text: Score = mean of the two players' adjusted damage × n/(n+10). Shared team context can affect both players.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #667085

g.text: This is a descriptive co-performance proxy. It does not isolate a causal synergy effect. Source: Oracle's Elixir.
